_doc: Règles nommées réutilisables dans les régions. Une règle peut appeler un autre helper (pas de récursion). has_explosives : dans le remake, sortir une bombe utilise l'action « soulever », il faut donc le Bracelet Goron en plus du sac (vérifié en jeu).

helpers.gc_chests: is_adult and (can_use(Megaton_Hammer) or has_strength2) and has_explosives
helpers.gtg_chests: is_adult and can_use(Progressive_Hookshot) and can_use(Bow) and has_explosives and can_see_invisible and can_use(Megaton_Hammer) and has_strength2 and can_use(Hover_Boots) and can_use(Iron_Boots)
helpers.ganon_castle_chests: can_use(Fire_Arrows) and can_use(Progressive_Hookshot) and can_use(Megaton_Hammer) and can_see_invisible and has_explosives and can_use(Hover_Boots) and has_strength2
helpers.shadow_boss: can_use(Hover_Boots) and can_use(Progressive_Hookshot) and can_use(Bow) and has_explosives and can_play(Zeldas_Lullaby)
helpers.rainbow_bridge: setting_is(bridge, 'open') or (setting_is(bridge, 'vanilla') and Shadow_Medallion and Spirit_Medallion and can_use(Light_Arrows)) or (setting_is(bridge, 'stones') and count(Kokiri_Emerald, Goron_Ruby, Zora_Sapphire) >= setting_value(bridge_count)) or (setting_is(bridge, 'medallions') and count(Forest_Medallion, Fire_Medallion, Water_Medallion, Spirit_Medallion, Shadow_Medallion, Light_Medallion) >= setting_value(bridge_count)) or (setting_is(bridge, 'dungeons') and count(Kokiri_Emerald, Goron_Ruby, Zora_Sapphire, Forest_Medallion, Fire_Medallion, Water_Medallion, Spirit_Medallion, Shadow_Medallion, Light_Medallion) >= setting_value(bridge_count)) or (setting_is(bridge, 'hearts') and hearts() >= setting_value(bridge_count))
